metadata.scope: Spoke wheels, o-ring tyre wheels, mecanum wheels, swivel castors, hub designs.

material_suggestions.notes: Good impact resistance and fatigue life for robot wheels.

material_suggestions.use_case: solid tyre overmoulding or printed tyre layer
material_suggestions.notes: Good grip on hard floors; print solid for best traction.
Hard-anodise for wear at spoke roots and hub bore.
Cord ø3 mm standard for 60–80 mm wheel OD; press into groove.

standards_used.name: O-ring groove standard (Parker)
standards_used.note: Cord ø3 mm: groove width 3.1 mm, groove depth 1.5 mm (50% compression for retention).

standards_used.name: DIN 7942 castor
standards_used.note: Wheel centre must be behind swivel axis by ≥ 15 mm for self-centering.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: 5-spoke robot wheel 80 mm OD with o-ring groove

spoke_length.note: clear span from hub to rim inner

main_features: spokes repeated around hub-to-rim radial span
o-ring groove around outer rim circumference
design_rules: rim is hollow cylinder: outer minus inner cylinder
spokes are cubes or hull() solids between hub and rim
spoke_count is parametric — use for-loop with 360/spoke_count angle
o-ring groove is annular recess subtracted from rim outer surface
failure_modes: solid disc instead of spoked wheel
even spoke count (use odd for stress distribution)
no o-ring groove — tyre falls off

constraint_checks.message: Spoked wheel rim should be a hollow ring, not a solid disk.
Spokes must use a for-loop for parametric count.
